In March, Brodashaggi was hospitalised after sustaining a gunshot injury while filming in Ogun State. This led many Nigerians to pray for his quick recovery.
In a video he shared online, he teased an upcoming tell-all about the incident, including footage of him being rushed to the hospital afterwards.
In his caption, Brodashaggi questions what happens when life hits pause.
Toke Makinwa wrote, “Welcome back. You’ve been missed and are thankful for life.
Cute Abiola wrote, “Melanin poppin. Fine boy, he don do new teeth again
Omowunmi Ajiboye wrote, “Thank you, Jesus; your healing is permanent IJN
In April, the skitmaker had written a message to God, telling Him that he was still holding on because He had asked him to. Brodashaggi said he is trusting God, still believing, and still waiting on Him. He noted how his Maker has never failed him and is confident that he wouldn’t.
Reacting to his post, N6 revealed that he had added Shaggy to his daily prayer list as he admonished the public to do the same. He stated that he doesn’t know what’s wrong with the skitmaker, but his latest post and captions have been very scary and depressing. He prayed that Heaven come through for him in his time of need.
Similarly, Cute Abiola, in an emotional video, sent a message to Brodashaggi, saying he misses his vibe and entertainment.
